title: Middle Eastern Zesty Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic pilaf dish with a zesty twist, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add pilaf mix and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add black pudding (if using) and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in Middle Eastern spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add lemon juice and cook until liquid has been absorbed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
